hook: ₹560 liquor sold as Johnnie Walker in *Shamshabad*
hook_b: ₹560 liquor sold as Johnnie Walker in *Shamshabad*
tldr: The Excise Task Force arrested two men in Shamshabad for filling cheap liquor into empty premium whisky bottles and selling them at higher prices.

beats.what: Officials seized 10 filled bottles and more than 30 empty premium bottles from a house in Sathamrai, Shamshabad.
beats.why: Excise officials say the main accused, a former distillery worker, mixed cheap liquor at home and passed it off as premium brands.
beats.care: Bottles were sold as Johnnie Walker, Dewar's and 100 Pipers; check seals and buy from licensed shops.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 17): the raid followed a tip-off; investigation is ongoing.

cards.q: Do you check bottle seals before buying liquor?

qs: How can buyers tell a refilled bottle from a sealed one?

facts.t: The liquor used costs about *₹560* a bottle and was sold as Johnnie Walker, Dewar's and 100 Pipers.

viz.verdict: Most bottles were still waiting to be refilled

watch: Further arrests as Excise officials trace who bought the refilled bottles.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Excise Task Force busts fake premium liquor racket in Shamshabad

fact: Shamshabad racket refilled premium whisky bottles with liquor costing about *₹560*
twist: The empty premium bottles came from a scrap shop; officials say they are now looking at the buyers' role too.
